extra_messages.content: You have stone tools and coal but stalled for ~80 steps; pivot to underground mining to find iron ore, craft a furnace from stone, and smelt iron ingots with your coal. Dig downward in a staircase pattern to reach iron-bearing layers quickly.

You've stalled for 80+ steps with no new progress, so dig underground to find iron ore in stone. Craft a furnace, smelt iron with your coal, and prioritize upgrading to iron tools to unlock deeper progression.
Dig underground into stone to find iron ore, then craft a furnace and smelt iron ingots with your coal. Prioritize making an iron pickaxe so you can eventually mine diamond before time runs out.

Stop wandering the surface and dig straight down through stone to find iron ore veins. Avoid all combat—focus solely on mining iron, then craft a furnace and smelt iron ingots with your coal to upgrade your pickaxe.
Craft a furnace from stone, then dig a staircase down into stone to find iron ore veins. Smelt iron with your coal and prioritize an iron pickaxe—avoid combat and keep food and drink topped up.

Previous attempts to dig straight down for iron keep dying quickly. Instead, explore the surface for a natural cave entrance where iron ore is exposed in the walls, and collect enough extra stone to craft a furnace before going underground.
